name: world-4x
title: I26 HD Textures 4x
note: The 4x world, car and cockpit pack as released in 2026.11.23, step by step in the order the release's files were made (docs/hd-textures.md). Run by tools/hd-pack.py world-4x. Placeholders: {export} the export, {masters} the 8x masters, {work} the work folder, {pack} the pack being built, {models} the models folder, {device} cuda or cpu, {tools} this folder's parent, {only} the step's textures, {names:...} and {pgm:...} names as separate arguments.

used_for.4xTextures_GTAV_rgt-s_dither.pth: most textures: 4x, then 2xHDCube_Compact to 8x (the masters), brought down
used_for.2xHDCube_Compact.pth: the masters' second pass (everything not in a family; the colour of gauges, needles, misc) and the seams' second pass
used_for.4xHDcube3_500k.pth: radar, damage panel, weapons, hands, gas pumps
used_for.4xHDcube-Alpha.pth: the cut-out outlines of gauges, needles, misc. (the alpha step)

steps.note: every texture of the install as an upright PNG (palette t01.act) and bottom-up.txt
the 8x masters of every texture up to 512 texels: the first model over the whole picture, as the release's first pass
the 53 textures of 513 to 640 texels, the first model in 128-texel tiles
every master colour matched to the original and brought down to 4x, BC7 (route 8b)
the cockpit by family (2026-11-04): each family's own model, the alpha step for the keyed shapes
where the textures meet a neighbour or repeat
the 115 kept seam textures upscaled in their neighbours' context (2026-11-05)
the game's smooth outline of each cut-out's key, at 4 texels a pixel
the cut-out scenery's alpha the smooth outline, its edge the original's colours (2026-11-06)
the gas pumps through 4xHDcube3_500k, colour matched (2026-11-06)
the four fronts' counter windows from the original (fixes/pump-counters.json), before the pumps are encoded
the pumps' PNGs as BC7 .dds into the pack
the cockpit's layout: where the damage panel's sprite cells are stamped
the damage panel's sprite sheets a cell at a time, on the CPU as the release's (2026-11-10)
the steering wheel's and the arms' outlines
the wheel's and the arms' frames recut by their smooth outline (2026-11-08)
the lettered textures set again from free fonts (the specs in tools/text-redraws/)
the barn doors' braces (2026-11-14) and the forecourt's border (2026-11-18): tools/text-redraws/fixes/
the painted-edge masks the release kept (hd-recipes/masks-cars.json)
the masks' smooth outlines
the cars' painted two-tone edges and small lamps, after their lettering (2026-11-08, the Dover 2026-11-09)

the radar's 62 frames drawn again over the pack's own (style B, the lock-range labels) and the range plate's and lamp's sheets made from them, which go with them (2026-11-26); the smooth sweep's layers beside them (zrads_face, zrads_grid.png, zrads.json); the glass and the panels' body wear at medium (the owner's pick)

the damage panel's wires drawn again as tubes fitted to the original's, and a medium wear (grime, chipped paint, fine scratches, an uneven print; the owner's pick) laid alike on the damage panel, its lights' every state and the counters' five housings, what the game stamps left as it is (2026-11-26)
pack.json, ATTRIBUTION.txt and FILES.sha256 from this recipe
